title: Hinomori Shizuku — By The Hand, To A Dream〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: By The Hand, To A Dream（4★）
meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand

rows.Line: Campground

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now, it's time to play...
Survival Camp! The fun and exciting game where you don't know what tools you're gonna get!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Haruka & Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're splitting into pairs by drawing names from a hat, and then making curry in those pairs, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! Fortune has placed Shizuku and Haruka in one pair, with myself and Minori in the other.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi and I will be making the curry!
That means you and Haruka will be making the rice, right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. Each pair has also been given a set of tools for chopping wood and starting a fire.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We get to use modern tools for chopping firewood and lighting fires.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We got an axe and...a strap drill.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What's a strap drill...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Basically, we have to spin a stick on a piece of wood to create enough friction to start a fire!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, we need to sandwich the stick vertically between two pieces of wood. Then, one of us will press down and hold the stick in place, while the other spins it by pulling on each end of the string wrapped around it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As it spins, the stick will heat up the wood on the bottom and create some tiny embers. In other words...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is gonna take a ton of time and effort!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
E-Eeeeepp...!
How did we end up with this?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this is a tool that needs two people to work as a team. S-So, you and I should be able to start a fire using this no problem!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You sound so excited, Minori.
Shall we also start getting ready, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. We can't let those two steal the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we break into our pairs and get started?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna do our best and make the best curry we can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, Shizuku, let's begin.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, starting with our firewood!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I always thought that chopping firewood involved splitting logs with an axe on top of a big wide log... But we get to use this handy tool today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. It's apparently designed to make the process a lot easier.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it's shaped like a cylinder... How do you think we're supposed to use it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Here, let me show you.
You put it on the ground with the blade facing upward, and you place a log on top of it inside the frame.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, just hit the top of the log with a hammer and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's incredible! It split them so quickly...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Easy, right?
It's your turn next. Do you feel ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I should be fine as long as I do what you just did. So, I place a log on the blade and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow...! Haruka, I did it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, nice job.
Let's maintain this energy and keep chopping more wood.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka, look! I made some really thin pieces!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow, that's pretty cool.
And we have so much now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was a little worried at first since I'm not very strong, but this makes everything so fun and easy♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Now that we have such a big pile, I think we can move on to starting our fire.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Starting our fire... That involves using that modern tool, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, this tool here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's a metal stick and a plate...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're called the rod and the striker. By hitting the rod hard with the striker, you get...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Sparks...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's amazing, Haruka. How do you know all this? Have you done this before by any chance?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I learned how to use tools like this way back when I was on this one survival program.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While you have the chance, Shizuku, why don't you give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure? I don't know if I'll be able to use them correctly...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't worry. Just do what I just did.
Scrape the two pieces against each other to create some sparks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Scrape the two pieces together...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Nothing happened...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You may need to use a little more force.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you're holding back a little because you're unconsciously afraid of the sparks going everywhere.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... You may be right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll give it another try.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More! Force!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: S-Still nothing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you still seem to be holding back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Try to give it everything you have.
You don't have to worry about it exploding or anything. Also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whether or not we get to have our curry depends on you right now, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our curry...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: R-Right...! If I can't get our fire started, we won't be able to cook any rice...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll give it everything I have.
Watch me, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Start!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I did it... I did it, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Way to go, Shizuku!
Now we can start cooking the rice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I did it... I started this fire...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Alone, I always thought that I couldn't do anything, but I've gotten to experience so many new things working with the others...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's so wonderful how I'm learning to do more and more.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, our fire's holding. Let's start getting the rice ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We need to make our rice as delicious as we can for the others' sake.
